Keep natural fluffy chest fur at chest level but trim away the long narrow dangling strip. The true two front legs and two hind legs must remain intact, with exactly FOUR anatomically plausible legs and FOUR paws supporting the cat. Keep the exact same recognizable round softly flat face, pale green eyes, pink nose, white muzzle, orange/black/white calico patch map, ears, fluffy single tail, body size, standing three-quarter pose and composition. Preserve fine photorealistic/semi-realistic fur detail and soft studio shadows. Complete cat ears, four paws and single tail within frame against seamless white. Only fix the faulty viewer-left lower-chest contour, avoid any other redesign. No text, no box, no annotations, no collar, no accessories.
